constraints: Use natural language similar to how a real employee would request a letter. Do not invent employee IDs or names — the bot shows them from its database.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: Employment letter edge - repeat request
goal: Test what happens when user requests employment letter twice in a row

phases.description: Request employment letter and see details card
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows employee details card with action buttons

phases.description: Request employment letter again without submitting the first one
phases.completionCriteria: Bot either shows the same card again, warns about duplicate, or handles gracefully
